newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hitachi up on semiconductor recovery hopes.
newsitem.headline: Hitachi up on semiconductor recovery hopes.

text.p: Shares in Hitachi Ltd were higher in early Wednesday morning trade, propelled by hopes that the semiconductor market is on the road to recovery, brokers said.
As of 0044 GMT, the shares were 20 yen higher at 1,050 yen with a trade volume of 2.675 million shares, the third most heavily traded issue.

Brokers said buying interest was focusing on high-tech shares due to bullishness in the U.S. NASDAQ composite index, which has recovered to the 1,200 level. Many high-technology shares are listed on that index.
